glossary.title: Glossary
glossary.description: Every technical term used on this site, explained in plain language. Terms are linked from their first use on each page.
glossary.intro: Terms are grouped by topic and sorted alphabetically. Each definition is written to be understood without a science background.

categories.pharmacology: How drugs work in the body

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: The full bibliography of this site: every study, regulatory document and law we cite, with DOI or official links.
sources.intro: Every source cited anywhere on this site. Scholarly sources link to their DOI. Regulatory and legal sources link to the official page and show when we last checked them.

search.title: Search
search.description: Search every page of this site. Search runs in your browser; nothing you type is sent anywhere.
search.label: Search the site
search.placeholder: For example: half-life, BPC-157, sharps container
search.noJs: Search needs JavaScript. Without it, use the list of all pages below.
search.noResults: No results. Try a shorter or different word.
search.privacy: Search runs in your browser. Your search words appear in the page address, so they can reach your browser history and our host's visit statistics.

news.title: Research and regulatory news
news.description: Headlines about peptides, metabolism and ageing research from regulators and research indexes we have vetted. Links go to the original source.
news.intro: These are headlines collected automatically from a short list of non-commercial sources: medicines regulators, anti-doping authorities and research indexes. We have checked the sources, not each item.
news.caution: One new study is one data point. A mouse result, a cell experiment or a preprint is not evidence that something works in people. Before acting on a headline, read
news.hintNote: Labels such as “Animal study” are added automatically from the title and summary and may be wrong.
news.empty: No items right now. The feed is refreshed daily.
news.leaving: Opens {source} in a new context. We are not responsible for external content.
news.sourcesListIntro: Each source is non-commercial and listed with the reason we trust it.
